author: Rafael Quintanilha
sender: Rafael Quintanilha, writing in the first person
task: Create a script that updates the IBX-100 portfolio in the QuantBrasil database from the B3 website
why_automation_matters: The IBX-100 is rebalanced every four months
source_constraints: The B3 table is generated dynamically with JavaScript
The table is inside an iframe
The table is paginated and shows only 20 rows by default
approach: Use Python and Playwright to load and interact with the page
Change the page-size selector to display all 100 assets
Parse the table and create or update the portfolio in PostgreSQL
result: The script opens the B3 page, finds all assets, and creates or updates the portfolio in a few seconds
availability: The recording is available on YouTube
The complete code is available in a public GitHub gist
